global_gating.principle: If attribution to the target player is unsafe, suppress the player-mechanics event rather than lowering confidence and emitting it.

required_signals: burst/trigger start evidence from ammo decrease and/or high-confidence recoil/muzzle temporal cue
shot.notes: MVP event granularity is burst/trigger start, not one event per bullet. Fuse >=5 fps ammo monitoring with visual cue. Ammo increase/reload/weapon-switch/purchase must not become shots.

required_signals: use-case-specific motion evidence: macro map displacement OR micro shot-time local optical-flow/weapon-bob evidence
movement_state.notes: For macro position/rotation, prefer minimap/zone displacement. For shot-time stationary/moving, prefer local world optical flow + weapon-bob at sub-second cadence; minimap is supporting evidence only. Conflicts become unknown.

required_signals: enemy visible in world view OR enemy marker becomes visible on minimap
enemy_spotted.notes: Only visible/recorded information; no hidden-position inference.

required_signals: previously confirmed enemy no longer visible for hysteresis window
enemy_spotted plus shot/damage/aim-contact OR mutual combat sequence
no visible enemy and no combat action for end-gap OR player death/round end
engagement_end.notes: Do not end on a single obscured frame.

required_signals: visible enemy-head or static corner reference when available
preaim_started.notes: MVP does NOT use homography/back-projected future head points. Deterministic lead_sec is allowed only in near-static/low-translation windows with trustworthy visible/static reference. Moving-peek cases fall back to semantic keyframes capped below deterministic-label confidence.

peek.notes: exposed_directions_count/exposed_directions may only come from static peek-exposure registry matched to a known position/anchor. If no registry match, omit/null; semantic VLM must not author it.

info_peek.notes: Intent is not directly observable; only emit at high confidence, otherwise keep ordinary peek only.

required_signals: location_text/zone_id change OR significant minimap displacement
position_change.notes: Can use normalized map positions when zone registry is unresolved.

required_signals: stable map position over minimum duration
position_hold.notes: Camera motion does not break a position hold if self-position is stable.

required_signals: sustained movement away from current site/zone toward another macro zone
rotation_started.notes: Requires resolved coarse macro zone/site grouping from map_zone_runtime_contract. If production map geometry is absent, emit diagnostic feature_unavailable and do not fabricate from/to. Auto site-anchor fallback may produce only low-confidence macro A/B/Mid groups.

required_signals: arrival/stable hold in target macro zone
rotation_completed.notes: Same map dependency as rotation_started; named destination requires static/coarse zone resolution.

required_signals: HUD ability charge/availability transition plus cast animation/world effect when observable
utility_used.notes: Purpose_observed is factual visible purpose, not evaluation; may be null/unknown.

required_signals: ally minimap marker moves through chokepoint/site boundary OR semantic minimap confirmation
ally_entry_start.notes: Requires site semantics. Static coarse zone geometry preferred; auto site-anchor fallback is allowed only at reduced confidence with persistence checks. If unresolved, TEAM-02 route is explicitly unavailable rather than silently missing.

required_signals: ally marker confirmed inside site zone OR semantic minimap confirmation
ally_enter_site.notes: Requires site semantics. Static coarse zone geometry preferred; auto site-anchor fallback is allowed only at reduced confidence with persistence checks. If unresolved, TEAM-02 route is explicitly unavailable rather than silently missing.

required_signals: engagement ended/lost then same/nearby enemy context reappears within configured window
enemy_reengage.notes: Identity can remain unknown; do not claim same named enemy unless supported.

hold_angle.notes: Useful for Operator and positioning context; suppress in smoke/fully obscured view when target line cannot be observed.

site_state.notes: Fields may be null/unknown independently. Do not force a full site-state judgment.

required_signals: visible utility effect and affected player/area
utility_effect_observed.notes: Only emit when effect is visibly attributable.

spike_pickup.notes: Optional for MVP. Emit only on direct evidence; otherwise leave absent.

spike_dropped.notes: Optional for MVP. Emit only on direct evidence; otherwise leave absent.

spike_defuse_started.notes: Optional for MVP. Emit only on direct evidence; otherwise leave absent.

spike_defused.notes: Optional for MVP. Emit only on direct evidence; otherwise leave absent.

required_signals: weapon inventory change plus world pickup evidence
weapon_pickup.notes: Optional for MVP. Emit only on direct evidence; otherwise leave absent.
